name: Canvas
brief: Canvas rendering context for ThorVG vector graphics.
description: Manages the rendering pipeline and provides methods for adding/removing Paint objects and controlling the render loop.

members.name: constructor
members.brief: Creates a new Canvas rendering context.
description: The renderer is determined by the global setting from ThorVG.init().

params.name: target
params.description: CSS selector for the target HTML canvas element (e.g., '#canvas', '.my-canvas'),                 the `HTMLCanvasElement` itself, or an `OffscreenCanvas`

warnings: {Error} If the canvas element is not found or renderer initialization fails

members.name: add
members.brief: Adds a Paint object to the canvas for rendering.
description: Paint objects include Shape, Scene, Picture, Text, and Animation.picture. Objects are rendered in the order they are added (painter's algorithm).

params.name: paint
params.description: A Paint object to add to the canvas

members.returns: The canvas instance for method chaining

members.name: remove
members.brief: Removes one or all Paint objects from the canvas.

params.name: paint
params.description: Optional Paint object to remove. If omitted, removes all Paint objects.

members.returns: The canvas instance for method chaining
examples:
// Remove a specific paint
canvas.remove(shape);

// Remove all paints
canvas.remove();

members.name: clear
members.brief: Clears all Paint objects from the canvas and renders an empty frame.
description: This is equivalent to `remove` without arguments, but also immediately renders the cleared canvas.
members.returns: The canvas instance for method chaining
examples: canvas.clear(); // Clears and renders empty canvas

members.name: update
members.brief: Updates the canvas state before rendering.
description: This method should be called before `render` when working with animations or when Paint objects have been modified. It ensures all transformations and changes are processed.
members.returns: The canvas instance for method chaining

members.name: render
members.brief: Renders all Paint objects to the canvas.
description: This method draws all added Paint objects to the canvas using the configured rendering backend (Software, WebGL, or WebGPU).
members.returns: The canvas instance for method chaining
examples:
// Static rendering
canvas.add(shape).add(text).render();

members.name: resize
members.brief: Resizes the canvas to new dimensions.
members.returns: The canvas instance for method chaining
examples: canvas.resize(1920, 1080).render();

members.name: viewport
members.signature: viewport(x: number, y: number, w: number, h: number): this
members.brief: Sets the viewport for rendering a specific region of the canvas.
description: The viewport defines the rectangular region where rendering occurs. Useful for rendering to a portion of the canvas or implementing split-screen views.

params.name: x
params.description: X coordinate of the viewport origin

params.name: y
params.description: Y coordinate of the viewport origin

members.returns: The canvas instance for method chaining
examples:
// Render to top-left quarter of canvas
canvas.viewport(0, 0, canvas.width / 2, canvas.height / 2);

members.name: destroy
members.brief: Destroys the canvas and frees its WASM memory.
description: After calling destroy(), this canvas instance cannot be used. The ThorVG module remains loaded and new canvases can be created.

members.name: renderer
members.brief: Gets the rendering backend type currently in use.
examples:
const canvas = new TVG.Canvas('#canvas', { renderer: 'wg' });
console.log(canvas.renderer); // 'wg'

members.name: dpr
members.brief: Gets the current device pixel ratio applied to this canvas.
description: ThorVG uses an optimized DPR formula for best performance: `1 + ((window.devicePixelRatio - 1) * 0.75)`
This provides a balance between visual quality and rendering performance, especially on high-DPI displays.
members.returns: The current effective DPR value, or 1.0 if DPR scaling is disabled
